lines.zh: 我一步一步走，背甲很重。
lines.en: I walk step by step, my shell heavy.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩在沙上，声音很闷。
lines.en: My claws press the sand with a dull sound.
I head for the dunes.

lines.zh: 我拖着背甲，一步一个沙印。
lines.en: I drag my shell along, one print per step.
I go around a hard stone.
I keep my head low and move slowly.
I pass between dry grasses.
I walk along the dry riverbed.
I climb the slope step by step.
I stop again for a breath.
I head for the shade.
I round a big stone.
I lie low with my head up, listening.
I bask my shell in the sun.
I lie on the sand like a stone.

lines.zh: 我把四条腿都缩进壳底。
lines.en: I tuck all four legs beneath my shell.
There is a layer of sand on my shell.
I turn my head slowly round.
I hear the wind through the dunes.
I did not even raise my head.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸慢得像没在喘。
lines.en: My breath is so slow it seems stopped.

lines.zh: 我把脖子收进去，只剩壳。
lines.en: I draw my neck in until only the shell shows.
I wait for it to cool.
I shake off some sand.
I shift my body.
I look into the distance without moving.
I turn my head to you.
You stand in my shadow.
I size you up slowly.
I shift a small half step toward you.
You raise a hand and I shrink back.
I stretch a claw forward.
I look at you for a while.
There is sand on you.

lines.zh: 我低下头，把脸贴近地面。
lines.en: I lower my head close to the ground.
I stop there again.
I yield the way without fuss.
Something sounds in my throat.
I set my claws on the sand.
I turn my head toward you slowly.
My shell throws back the light.
I glance at your boots.
I flinch and give half a step.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在甲上，闷闷一响。
lines.en: That lands on my shell with a muffled knock.

lines.zh: 我一点一点把身子稳住。
lines.en: I settle myself bit by bit.
Blood seeps from a shell seam.
Hurting, my legs still hold.
I retreat toward the stone.
My breathing is fierce.
I pull my head into my shell.
I keep that on my shell.
These four legs can still move.
I sniff and ease closer.
I clamp my jaws shut on it.
This is not very fresh.
I grind it mouthful by mouthful.
I look for more.

lines.zh: 我用下巴把食物按在沙上。
lines.en: I pin the food to the sand with my chin.
I eat contentedly.
That little is not enough for me.
I drag it into the shade.
When done I lick my claw.
I stretch my head over to sniff.
I eat with sand all over my mouth.
One knock and I give half a step.
I have a shell; I do not shift easily.
I turn aside slowly.
I stepped on your claw.
I lower my head to guard.
I shift over to one side.
This heavy, I will not be shoved.
I stand quite steady.
I dislike being struck.
Do not hit me with your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我挪到它身边，壳挨着壳。
lines.en: I shuffle up beside it until our shells touch.
It leans its head in.
We lie side by side on the sand.

lines.zh: 我伸出前爪，轻轻碰它的壳。
lines.en: I reach out a foreclaw and tap its shell.
When it moves, the sand slides.
We bask side by side.
It goes and I follow slowly.
No one made a sound.
I shoulder it a little away.
I settle back down.

lines.zh: 我张嘴咬住，连沙一起吞。
lines.en: I bite down and swallow the sand with it.
I clamp it with a claw.
The shell is too hard to crack.
I drag it under my feet.
I swallow mouthful by mouthful.
I spat it straight out.
I press it into the sand.
I taste it; it is salty.
I keep it for slow chewing.
I look for the next piece.
Something moves on the sand.
I turn my head that way.
I have it ringed in my eye.
I lower my shell.
I edge toward it.
It is too near my dunes.
I draw my claws in a little.
I am fully ready.

lines.zh: 我一步挨一步地靠过去。
lines.en: I close in step upon step.
I growl low at it.

lines.zh: 我把爪子前面的沙拨开。
lines.en: I sweep the sand from in front of my claws.
It has trampled my sand.
My eyes are stuck to it.

lines.zh: 它绕多少圈，我的壳就转向它。
lines.en: However many times it circles, my shell turns to follow.
I stand between it and the dunes.
It comes near and I settle lower.
I have all day.
I drop my head.
My claws dig into the sand.
It backs off and I will not chase far.

lines.zh: 它再过来一点，我就动手。
lines.en: A little closer and I strike.
It has lost its footing.
I keep to the sand without a sound.

lines.zh: 它的一举一动我都收着。
lines.en: I hold every move it makes.
I drop my head and ram.
I strike it with a claw.
That knocks it over.
I pin it against the stone.
It cuts me and my shell holds.
I land a second butt.

lines.zh: 一整副壳压得它陷进沙。
lines.en: My whole shell bears it down into the sand.
It withdraws and I hold.
I pant with my shell held straight.
I fight no more.
I kick sand into its face.
I bear down with my whole body.
I push up out of the sand.
Sand lies everywhere here.
I shake the sand from my shell.
I look around first.
I walk toward that stone.
I straighten my body little by little.
The smell of dry grass drifts from the dunes.
I stop to sun myself.

lines.zh: 日头正顶，我的影子缩在壳下。
lines.en: The sun is overhead; my shadow hides under my shell.
I walk toward the dunes.

lines.zh: 我把四只爪子一起按进沙里。
lines.en: I press all four claws into the sand at once.
I walk toward the dead tree.

lines.zh: 热从壳缝钻进来，烫得我直蹬。
lines.en: Heat seeps through my shell seams and my legs kick.

lines.zh: 落地时我四条腿都沉下去。
lines.en: All four legs drive down on landing.
Water floods my mouth and I cannot lift my head.
The blast rolls me onto my side.

lines.zh: 箭头楔进壳缝，卡得很深。
lines.en: The arrowhead wedged deep into a seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 一道术式扣住我，我动不了。
lines.en: An art clamps on me and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，我没力了。
lines.en: Too long unfed and my strength is gone.

lines.zh: 雷打在甲上，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shell and I lock up.
No sand and no ground below.
